name: Kisan-Sathi
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: An Offline-First Mobile Agricultural Assistant & Digital Ledger

Kisan-Sathi is a mobile-first, fully offline agricultural support tool designed to run directly on a farmer's device. It targets real-world agricultural problems in areas with poor or absent network connectivity by executing inference locally using ultra-efficient edge language models.
features: 💬 Ask Sathi (कृषि सलाहकार): Dual-language (Hindi/English) chatbot grounded in local agricultural guides for Kanpur Dehat, UP.

📅 Personalized Crop Calendar (फसल कैलेंडर): Dynamic timelines generated from templates using the crop sowing date. Allows adding multiple calendars, tracking checkable tasks, highlighting the next action in the nudge…
📞 Local Emergency Directory (स्थानीय संपर्क): A list of verified local agricultural officers and scientists.
